outcome: Fulfilment of SDT's basic psychological needs (autonomy, competence, and relatedness)
cohort: Nine primiparous (first-time) mothers participated in an 8-week telephone-based Co-Active Life Coaching intervention.
finding: The study found that both detractors (motherhood-specific challenges) and supporters (being kind to oneself) influenced the fulfillment of SDT's basic psychological needs in the context of health behaviour change, with the coaching relationship and telephone delivery mode being particularly helpful.
